item.text:
**Overall:** yes, with one caution. I found no credible 2024 evidence that Lula tried to bypass term limits or block constitutional transfer of power. The main caveat is that his 2026 succession plan remained open-ended, but the comments I found still stayed within electoral rules.

- [Lula diz que Bolsonaro não retornará à Presidência e defende candidato jovem para 2026](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/02/lula-diz-que-bolsonaro-nao-retornara-a-presidencia-e-defende-candidato-jovem-para-2026.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-07-02 - Lula framed Bolsonaro’s return as over, said Brazil must “learn to like democracy,” and treated 2026 succession as an electoral matter with a younger successor preferred. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.1.

- [Lula afirma que pode ser candidato à reeleição em 2026 para evitar volta de "trogloditas"](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/18/lula-afirma-que-pode-ser-candidato-a-reeleicao-em-2026-para-evitar-volta-de-trogloditas.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-06-18 - Lula said a 2026 run was not his first option and would depend on whether his coalition had another viable candidate. That is a succession-uncertainty signal, but not a term-limit breach. Question IDs: 4B.8.

- [Lula diz que estará "pronto" se não houver outro candidato para enfrentar extrema-direita em 2026](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/11/08/lula-diz-que-estara-pronto-se-nao-houver-outro-candidato-para-enfrentar-extrema-direita-em-2026.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-11-08 - Lula again left the door open to another candidacy if his party bloc had no successor, while stressing he would decide “with sobriety” and in discussion with allied parties. This is cautious, not anti-constitutional, but it shows succession planning was unresolved. Question IDs: 4B.8.

- [Lula minimiza divergências com Congresso e diz que todas as propostas do governo serão aprovadas](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/04/23/lula-minimiza-divergencias-com-congresso-e-diz-que-todas-as-propostas-do-governo-serao-aprovadas.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-04-23 - Lula described disagreements with Congress as normal politics and said disputes can be solved through political bargaining, which supports coalition governance rather than personalist rule. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.4.

- [Lula diz que não tem candidatos para presidentes da Câmara e do Senado](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/09/05/lula-diz-que-nao-tem-candidato-nem-para-a-camara-nem-para-o-senado.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-09-05 - Lula said the choice of congressional leaders belongs to the parties and lawmakers, not to him personally. That is good evidence of respecting coalition autonomy and parliamentary succession rules. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.4.

- [Lula diz acreditar que não seria possível tentativa de golpe de Estado sem Bolsonaro](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/02/08/lula-diz-acreditar-que-nao-seria-possivel-tentativa-de-golpe-de-estado-sem-bolsonaro.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-02-08 - Lula backed investigation of the alleged coup plot and called the election-denial behavior serious, which supports constitutional transfer-of-power norms rather than toleration of anti-democratic shortcuts. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.1, 4B.5.

- [Partidos de centro e da direita consolidam vitória no 2º turno das eleições municipais](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/10/27/partidos-de-centro-e-da-direita-consolidam-vitoria-no-2-turno-das-eleicoes-municipais.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-10-27 - Opposition and center-right forces won most major municipal races, including Lula’s setback in São Paulo, and the coverage shows no sign of retaliation or refusal to accept the results. This is strong practical evidence of acceptance of electoral turnover. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.1, 4B.3.

- [Brazil | Freedom House Freedom in the World 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/brazil/freedom-world/2024) - Freedom House - 2024 - Brazil remained a competitive democracy with active public debate, which is supportive background for constitutional transfer of power under Lula. It is not Lula-specific proof, but it helps bound the claim. Question IDs: 4B.8, 4B.1.

Search gap: I did not find solid 2024 evidence of Lula violating term limits, refusing to accept succession, or blocking constitutional transfer of power. The only real negative material is his repeated openness to being the fallback 2026 candidate, but that is still within Brazil’s electoral rules and does not show unconstitutional entrenchment.
